description: This Java class `ApplicationConfig` serves as a Spring Boot configuration class for the Device Connection service in the Eclipse Hono project. It defines beans for Vert.x instances, OpenTracing Tracer, service properties, AMQP endpoint handlers, remote cache management, metrics, and health check endpoints.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for Device Connection service, defining various beans for service setup and integration.

methods.name: vertx
methods.description: Creates and exposes a Vert.x instance configured with properties.

methods.name: vertxProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for Vert.x via Spring Boot configuration properties.

methods.name: getTracer
methods.description: Exposes an OpenTracing Tracer bean, resolved via service lookup or defaults to a no-op tracer.

methods.name: applicationConfigProperties
methods.description: Provides general application properties related to the Device Registry.

methods.name: amqpProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for AMQP 1.0 endpoint.

methods.name: deviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Factory method for DeviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint bean, prototype scope.

methods.name: server
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeviceConnectionAmqpServer, configured as a prototype-scoped bean.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory bean for producing instances of the AMQP server.

methods.name: remoteCacheProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for connecting to the remote Infinispan cache.

methods.name: remoteCacheManager
methods.description: Creates and exposes a RemoteCacheManager for interacting with the remote cache.

methods.name: deviceConnectionService
methods.description: Provides an implementation of the device connection service backed by remote cache.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Customizes the MeterRegistry with common tags for metrics.

methods.name: healthCheckProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for the health check endpoint.

methods.name: healthCheckServer
methods.description: Creates and exposes the health check server instance.
